title: Rejection rate after three-query conversion
statement: Let $n\ge 1$, let $P$ be a property of Boolean strings of length $n$, and let a probabilistically checkable proof description for $P$ have query count $r>0$ and rejection rate $\rho$. The rejection rate of its three-query description is $\rho/(r2^r)$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a property of Boolean strings of length $n$
The input is a PCPP description for $P$
